messages:
Maddie H.: Heads-up: AuburnAI reported missing audit entries for inference S3 delivery window (approx 6h). SOC wants assurance before renewal discussion next Tue. Any quick wins? https://go/runbooks/auburn-onboard
Priya K.: On call now. Initial observation: some S3 objects show null SSE header and delivery counts dipped ~40% starting 03:00Z. They provided manifest with ~14 suspect files.
Kyra L.: Spinning up agent checks. Can someone paste a sample S3 event?
Maddie H.: Sample event (redacted): "2026-03-20T18:03:12Z PutObject auburn-logs-prod x-amz-server-side-encryption: null"
Josh R.: Likely IAM/kms perms. Forwarder role might not have kms:Decrypt after recent key rotation. I'll grep CloudTrail for forwarder errors.
Samir V.: Marking renewal_risk: medium until we confirm delivery and can replay. If SOC can't prove immutability they will push for credit/extended SLA.
eng-deploy-bot: Agent status: auburn-vpc-agent-2 heartbeat @ 2026-03-20T17:58:45Z 1 healthy
Kyra L.: Confirmed: role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-logs-forwarder-auburn is missing kms:Decrypt in its inline policy. Creating INFRA ticket.
Josh R.: Also check whether Auburn is using client-side encryption (CSE). If CSE, SSE headers would be null legitimately.
Priya K.: On the call they said SSE-KMS server-side. So forwarder is the likely culprit. They also requested 13-month retention, annual rotation, and a 30-day playback bundle for the auditor.
Samir V.: Security wants a signed proof bundle: S3 manifests, KMS metadata, CloudTrail events, and hash digests for the 30 day window. If gaps exist, we must log and propose remediation.
Kyra L.: Ticket INFRA-4821 created. Remediation plan: (1) add kms:Decrypt + kms:GenerateDataKey to forwarder role (PR), (2) restart forwarder agent, (3) re-run delivery job for missing window and produce manifests. PR ETA ~2h.
Maddie H.: I'll communicate plan and ETA to customer; keep renewal_risk flagged.
Josh R.: Example IAM snippet to add:
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
}
```
Kyra L.: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1298 1 includes policy change + deployment job. CI green, merge scheduled in 10m.
eng-deploy-bot: CI passed for PR 1298. Merge approved.
Samir V.: Post-merge ops checklist: verify S3 object SSE headers, confirm CloudTrail entries showing forwarder kms:Decrypt calls, validate Splunk ingest counts for delivery window, generate signed proof bundle.
Priya K.: I'll draft a short runbook for Auburn: delta alert for delivery rate < 95%, steps to replay missing window, and how we produce the signed proof bundle. Will share draft for review.
Maddie H.: Owners: Kyra (INFRA-4821), Josh (KMS verification + CloudTrail), Samir (security proof bundle), Priya (customer comms + runbook). Check back in 3h. :thumbsup:
